content: Act as an adversarial code reviewer using three independent subagents from the perspectives of tool implementer, reviewer, and AI consumer; iterate over multiple rounds to converge on issues, use tool-based closed-loop real errors as the basis for fixes, and use checklists as fallback validation.
Wants unclear technical issues to be explained in an understandable way when they say they do not understand them.
Prefers the assistant to directly implement its recommended fixes instead of asking for further confirmation.
Prefers interacting in Chinese while mixing common English technical terms such as README, releases, MCP, and CLI.
